<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs=""
>
[See You in Hell](/Feats.aspx?ID=5269) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 81

**Frequency**
once per day

**Trigger**
You are reduced to 0 Hit points by a creature but not immediately killed.

</column>

---

You aren't sure if you'll be reincarnated again, so you might as well take this foe with you. A blast of spiritual energy lashes out from the depths of your soul, targeting the creature who attacked you. The creature takes mental damage equal to the amount that reduced you to 0 Hit Points (basic Will save with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).
name: See You in Hell
primary_source: Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web
primary_source_raw: Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web pg. 81
